AvatarProps.name: name
AvatarProps.description: Describes the person. Required when `src` is set — it is the image's alt.

AvatarProps.name: fallback
AvatarProps.description: Shown when there is no image. Defaults to the initials of `name`.

BadgeProps.name: dot
BadgeProps.description: Show a leading dot. On `tone="live"` it pulses.

HeadingProps.name: level
HeadingProps.description: The document outline. Required, and deliberately separate from `size`.

IconProps.name: label
IconProps.description: What the icon means. Omit it when the icon is decorative — when the text beside it already says the same thing — and the icon is hidden from assistive technology instead.

InputProps.name: invalid
InputProps.description: Marks the control invalid and lets `Field` wire the error message.
